# Why won't this contacts file import cleanly?

> Free vCard (.vcf) checker: finds cards with no FN or N, bad email and phone values, impossible birthdays, quoted-printable text, unclosed cards, identical duplicates and wrong line endings that make Google Contacts, Apple Contacts and Outlook skip or garble contacts, and writes the file back fixed.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
